title: Advanced options
invalid: Review the advanced options. Use valid public URLs, complete every targeting row, and make activation earlier than expiry.
utc: All dates and times are in UTC. Leave a field empty to remove its restriction.
approximate: Includes non-bot visits and QR scans. Concurrent and queued visits may exceed this limit.
geoHelp: Up to 10 country rules. Use two-letter country codes, such as DK. The first matching rule wins.
deviceHelp: Up to 10 device rules. Choose an operating system, a device type, or both. The first matching rule wins.
rotationHelp: Up to 10 destinations. Positive weights set relative shares, and returning visitors keep the same branch.
rowCount: {count, plural, one {# rule configured} other {# rules configured}} · Up to 10
deepLinkHelp: Use public HTTPS app links or supported app schemes. Store fallback requires a store URL for each configured platform.
permanentHelp: Browsers may cache permanent redirects. Use this only for destinations you expect to keep.
utmHelp: Optional UTM overrides apply to destination redirects. Campaign variants remain managed in the UTM tab.
socialHelp: Custom metadata is shown to link-preview bots. The image must use a public HTTPS URL.
